1 [[Tanned Hide Square]] | collector = [[Chef Panjoh]] }} [[Skale Fin]]s are [[drop]]ped by the [[Skale]] that populate the rivers of [[Istan]]. Skale Fins are considered a delicacy by the Istani, and are prized by chefs for this reason. ==Acquisition== * [[Nightfall]] ** [[Istan]] *** [[Frigid Skale]] *** [[Hungry Skale]] *** [[Razorback Skale]] *** [[Ridgeback Skale]] *** [[Skale Blighter]] *** [[Skale Lasher (Nightfall)|Skale Lasher]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Skale Fin#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ====[[Fahranur, The First City]]==== Leave [[Jokanur Diggings (outpost)|Jokanur Diggings]] and take the north path towards the city ruins. Directly opposite the entrance to the city there is a large cluster of level 2 Skale. ====[[Issnur Isles]]==== Leave from [[Beknur Harbor]]. There are many groups of Skale in the shallow waters directly south and east of the outpost. ====[[Zehlon Reach]]==== Leave [[The Astralarium]] into Zehlon Reach. Head west through two groups of [[insects]]. After you are through the insects the northeast part of Zehlon Reach is mostly Skale. ====[[Beknur Harbor]] (explorable area only during the quest - Assault on Beknur Harbor)==== ''Prerequisites:'' * [[Elona|Elonian]] [[character]] * Having finished [[Voices in the Night]] and [[Moa'vu'Kaal, Awakened]] * ''Not'' having finished [[Assault on Beknur Harbor]] Speak to [[Elder Jurdu]] in [[Beknur Harbor]] to get teleported to this quest-exclusive area. Walk to the wooden gate and defend the harbor from six incoming waves. All these waves consist exclusively of skales, split up into several groups of 4-7 skales. The [[boss]] [[Glug Klugg]] will be part of the final wave. Back at the outpost, abandon the quest, then talk to Elder Jurdu again. The advantage of this approach is convenience: * The quest requires almost no walking and can be easily be completed in 6-8 minutes with 3-4 [[hero]]es in [[normal mode]] while demanding barely any active input by the player. Due to the sheer mass of skales, this will still yield about 1-2 fins per run. * After successful completion, the player will be teleported to the outpost with the [[Unclaimed Items]] panel appearing, so no items have to be actively picked up either. ==Collectors== {{:Chef Panjoh/Collector}} [[Category:Ongoing drop research]]
